content.name: Alyssa Moreno
content.title: Recruiter
content.summary: Recruiter with three years at a fast-growing healthcare staffing firm, moving from intern to coordinator to full-cycle recruiter. Fills 6 to 8 nursing and allied health roles a month and lifted candidate show rates for interviews from 68% to 86%.

experience.title: Recruiter
bullets: Run full-cycle recruiting for travel and local nursing and allied health roles, averaging seven placements a month.
Source candidates through LinkedIn Recruiter, Indeed and referral campaigns, keeping a pipeline of about 120 active candidates.
Verify Texas and compact nursing licenses and certifications before submittal, with zero compliance holds this year.
Added text reminders and a prep call before interviews, raising show rates from 68% to 86%.

experience.title: Recruiting Coordinator
bullets: Scheduled about 60 candidate interviews a week across 12 hiring managers in Greenhouse.
Built offer letter and background-check templates that cut offer turnaround from three days to one.
Hosted a monthly virtual open house that brought in 25 to 40 new applicants each session.

experience.title: Talent Acquisition Intern
bullets: Screened 400 applications for entry-level patient care roles against posted requirements.
Cleaned 2,000 duplicate candidate records in the applicant tracking system.
Shadowed recruiters on phone screens and wrote screening notes for 50 candidates.

achievements.title: Show rate 68% to 86%
achievements.detail: Interview reminder and prep-call process at Hill Country Health Staffing.

achievements.title: Intern to recruiter in 23 months
achievements.detail: Promoted twice at the same firm.
